_source: Story 054, decision D-062. How a room's ground is dressed by GroundDresser (src/world/ground_dresser.gd). 'default' applies to every theme; a theme's own block (keys from data/world/themes.json) overrides single keys. margin_cells: rock drawn around the room (cells) so a zoomed-out camera never shows a void past the room's edge. shade: darkness laid over solid rock by distance from open air in cells (index 0 = the surface, the last value for anything deeper), so every walkable edge is lit and the mass below falls into black. shade_z: how far in front of the rock face that darkness sits. top_shade: darkness on the top of the rock behind the walkable slabs, [front, back]. cap_back_z: how far back the walkable slab strip reaches (the play plane is z 0, the rock face z 1.2). slab_len: slab lengths (m). chip_chance: share of slabs with a broken front. block_w / block_h: carved stone blocks on the face under each edge (m), block_skip the share left out, block_row2 the share of the second row. accent: what hangs off or runs along the edge ('moss' strands, 'roots' with glowing drips, 'gold' moulding, 'embers' in the joints), accent_every its spacing (m). teeth_every / teeth_len: rock teeth under every overhang (m), at most teeth_room of the free space below. pebbles_every: loose stones on the lip (m).
